newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets Norsk Hydro buy of fertiliser unit.
newsitem.headline: EU vets Norsk Hydro buy of fertiliser unit.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday it had started a routine review of plans by a Dutch unit of Norwegian oil and gas giant Norsk Hydro to buy EniChem's fertiliser unit at Terni Industrie Chimiche SpA.

In a statement, the European Union executive said the companies on September 24 submitted the deal for clearance under the EU's merger regulation, which bans the creation or strengthening of a dominant position.

The Commission, which vets all corporate mergers above a certain size, has one month to decide whether to approve the deal or start a detailed investigation if it fears it could harm competition in the 15-nation EU.
Almost all mergers are cleared after the first stage.
Under the deal that was announced on September 5, Hydro Agri Nederland BVA, a unit of Norsk Hydro, acquires control of Terni Inudstrie Chimiche, a wholly owned subsidiary of Enichem.
